info.name: OpenGov Purchase Order Receipt Sync API

params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

items.docs: Processes receipt allocation updates using full-replacement semantics. Accepts receipt header and line items with accepted quantities. Replaces all previous allocations for the receipt and triggers accepted quantity recompute. Idempotent: replayed requests (same idempotencyKey) return 200; new requests return 202.
